purpose: Answer-isolated public validation of proposal or faithful extraction, bounded support, local applicability, and host decision as four separate facts.
invariants: Every retained proposal has exactly one decision link.
Only supported plus applicable may be admitted.
Rejected is reserved for structural or policy failure and has support and applicability not-evaluated.
Unsupported means insufficient supporting evidence and is not contradiction.
Contradicted requires a visible, directly opposing, SHA-256-bound artifact.
Ordinary unavailability abstains; only deliberate deletion is audit-only.
A source producer has no local-applicability authority and cannot admit a local conclusion.
Source-consumer applicability facts are answer-free inputs separate from producer output.

fingerprint_basis.span_coordinates: zero-based UTF-8 byte offsets, start inclusive and end exclusive
